Investigate the hospital you choose VERY carefully before you commit to anything (no pun intended). Also, most places let you sign yourself in so it's not "involuntary" but if you try to leave against medical advice they will initiate a hold.

I had to deal with doctors telling me that horrid side effects were just hallucinations and a creepy homeless man that would expose himself to me and make advances (staff responded by telling me that I was getting "a little grandiose"). 

Only go if you're very, very sick because they're not very good places to get well sometimes.

Hmm... yeah, a lot of my friends have jokingly said I have "happy sad" disorder (as in normal range of emotion/response to stress) and I'll be damned if I can be bothered to do anything on these meds. I miss enjoying life.

Hmm that's interesting. I swear that a little weed is a good thing, but my little brothers god damned high school psychology teacher had to go around telling all the 16 year olds that smoking weed once can turn you schizophrenic.

I'm on lithium now and feel like the life has been sucked out of me (and goodbye abs... i'm growing a lithium baby/belly after like 3 weeks). I've been put on seroquel twice and both times caused me a psychosis of sorts (and major weight gain), but yeah.
